_comment: Silver-gate shared pattern config. Used by pre-commit hook, silver-gate-repo.mjs, and silver-gate.ts. Severity: block = reject commit, warn = print only. Patterns follow Safe Harbor de-identification methodology (HIPAA 18 identifiers) plus content-voice guardrails.

pii.name: Key Assignment
pii.note: hardcoded credential-like assignment; excludes env-var references like ${VAR:?msg}

pii.name: ZIP Code
pii.note: 5-digit ZIP or ZIP+4 — excludes year-like patterns 19xx/20xx

pii.name: Date (ISO or US)
pii.note: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD — possible birth/admission/discharge date

pii.name: Personal URL
pii.note: URL to personal social media profile

internal_framing.name: company-rule
internal_framing.note: internal organizational framing; allowed in internal SOP callouts

internal_framing.name: org-framing
internal_framing.pattern: \b(our team|we use|at GridLab|@ GridLab|GridLab starter|GridLab intern|GridLab employee|works at GridLab)\b

internal_framing.name: internal-training
internal_framing.pattern: \b(homework|tell Ike|ask Ike|come in ready|hand in|bring to class|bring to session)\b

internal_framing.name: client-framing
internal_framing.pattern: \b(my client|our client|the client['']s\b|a client of|client work)\b

family_references.name: possessive-family
family_references.note: possessive family reference — direct personal disclosure

reader_description.name: reader-life-stage
reader_description.pattern: \b(new (parent|mom|dad|father|mother|hire|employee|developer|programmer|engineer|manager|grad|graduate)|first[ -]time (parent|mom|dad|user|developer)|retired person|senior citizen|elderly person|young professional|career changer|bootcamp grad)\b
reader_description.note: describing the reader's life stage — invasive

reader_description.name: reader-skill-condescending
reader_description.note: describing the reader's limited skills — invasive

reader_description.name: written-for-reader
reader_description.pattern: \b(written for|designed for|aimed at|built for|targeting|meant for|created for|intended for)\s+a\s+(high school|middle school|elementary|college|teen|young|new|beginner|elderly|senior|first[ -]time|inexperienced|non[ -]technical|lay|junior)\s+(student|kid|person|reader|user|developer|programmer|engineer|writer|designer|adult|child|citizen|professional)\b
reader_description.note: describing who the document is for in personal terms

reader_description.name: reader-assumption
reader_description.pattern: \b(you (are|'re) a|you're an|as a|as an|being a|being an)\s+(high school|middle school|elementary|college|teen|young|new|beginner|elderly|senior|first[ -]time|inexperienced|non[ -]technical|lay|junior|retired|student)\s+(student|kid|person|reader|user|developer|programmer|engineer|writer|designer|adult|child|citizen|professional|parent|mom|dad)\b

reader_description.name: your-role
reader_description.note: role reference; allowed in internal training, review for public copy

reader_description.name: reader-ignorance
reader_description.pattern: \b(if you('| a)ve never|if you don'?t know|you probably don'?t know|you may not know|you might not know|chances are you|you haven't heard|you're probably wondering|you might be wondering|I know what you're thinking|you're probably asking|you might be asking)\b
reader_description.note: pretending to know what the reader doesn't know — invasive

reader_description.name: cheerleading
reader_description.pattern: \b((that's|that is) your (first|next|big) (win|victory|achievement|accomplishment|success|milestone)|you('ve| have) got this|I('| a)m (so |really )?proud of you|way to go|you did it|you're doing great|keep it up|good job|well done|you should be proud|pat yourself on the back)\b

reader_description.name: fake-empathy
reader_description.pattern: \b(I understand|I get it|I know|I hear you|that's (totally |completely )?(valid|fair|understandable|normal|okay)|it's (totally |completely )?(valid|fair|understandable|normal|okay) to feel|don't worry|no worries|take a deep breath|you've got this|it can be (scary|intimidating|overwhelming|daunting))\b
reader_description.note: fake-empathy AI voice — the AI doesn't have feelings

reader_description.name: scripted-words
reader_description.note: scripting someone else's exact words — invasive
